final: WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, execution_count * 1.0 / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM execution_counts), differences AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_minus_average, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM differences) SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_minus_average FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 10 ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
